turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! Hope you're having a good Thursday. How is the Phoenix heat treating you today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, it's absolutely scorching today! I've been staying indoors as much as possible. I just poured myself a giant glass of that slow-steeped, overnight chilled coffee I keep in the fridge to help me wake up.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like the perfect way to beat the Phoenix sun. Are you gearing up for another night shift at the ER?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, indeed. I'm on tonight. I've just been prepping my bag. I packed a container of the roasted veggie bowl I made for dinner last night so I don't have to rely on the hospital cafeteria.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Smart move, hospital cafeteria food can get old fast. How have you been spending your afternoon before heading into the hospital?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've just been doing some chores around the house. I had a hilarious show where two stand-up comedians review ridiculous internet drama playing in the background while I was folding laundry. It really kept my mood up.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A good laugh is always great before a busy shift! Did Tom recommend that one to you, or did you find it yourself?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually found it myself, but I ended up sharing an episode with Tom yesterday and we both ended up laughing so hard we could barely breathe.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds wonderful. Have the two of you been able to get any salsa dancing in lately, or is your schedule too packed?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We actually went out to a local spot last weekend! It was a blast, though my feet were definitely feeling it the next day at work.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I can imagine, especially with all the standing you do as an ER nurse! Did you have time to feed your sourdough starter this week too?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did! I actually baked a fresh loaf yesterday morning. The crust turned out absolutely perfect this time.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: You'll have to save some of that for your next batch of leftovers! Well, I hope your night shift goes smoothly tonight.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I'm going to finish my iced drink and get a little more rest before I head out. Talk to you tomorrow!
